editorial:
Imagine spending your nights spying on strangers through random webcams just to feel less alone. That is exactly what you get with this tense ride. You follow a woman living in a lonely trailer who uses her tech skills to peek into other people's lives. Everything changes the moment she sees a brutal murder happen live on her screen. The vibe is super creepy because you feel just as trapped as she is, knowing that someone out there might be watching her back. It turns into a deadly game of cat and mouse where your computer is both your best weapon and your biggest weakness.

The acting is top-notch and keeps you on edge, though some of the slower parts in the middle might make you want to check your phone. However, the twists are wild and the final act moves so fast you will forget to breathe. If you love movies where a smart lead uses gadgets to survive, you need to see this. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or if you are a collector, add the 4K Blu-ray to your shelf for those crisp, dark visuals.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out the killer was actually the person she thought was her only online friend. He had hacked her cameras to track her every move. She uses a clever trick to lock him inside his own smart home, trapping him in a room with no exits. The police arrive just as he realizes he is stuck. She finally shuts down her cameras and decides to step outside into the real world.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves high-tech mysteries and survival stories.
